> *Substitute *$a=ax^{2}$*, *`b equals open parentheses negative 1 over x squared close parentheses`* and *$n=6$* into the formula for a general term *`open parentheses table row n row r end table close parentheses a to the power of n minus r end exponent b to the power of r`

`open parentheses table row 6 row r end table close parentheses open parentheses a x squared close parentheses to the power of 6 minus r end exponent open parentheses negative 1 over x squared close parentheses to the power of r`

`table row cell 2 open parentheses 6 minus r close parentheses minus 2 r end cell equals 0 row cell 12 minus 2 r minus 2 r end cell equals 0 row 12 equals cell 4 r end cell row r equals 3 end table`

**[A1]**

> *Substitute *$r=3$* back into the general term*

`open parentheses table row 6 row 3 end table close parentheses equals 20`

> *Substitute this back into the term to get the final answer*

$-20a^{3}$
